query: Our site looks so generic, like every other SaaS template out there. Show me a couple of totally different looks for it using our real copy so I can pick one.
Can you put together a moodboard or stylescape for a natural wine bar called Sediment? I want to see options before we commit to colors or fonts.
I love the look of Aesop and Teenage Engineering and I hate corporate blue. Build three full-page homepage mockups for my architecture studio, each in a different style.
We want to redesign our nonprofit's website but the board can't agree on a style. I need side-by-side options they can actually look at and vote on.
Here's the direction we picked. Build the tonal ramps and a dark mode from its two colors and check every text pairing for contrast.
Turn our chosen colors, type scale and spacing into CSS variables for the codebase.
Review this landing page I designed against our brand guidelines before it goes live.
